transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. Um... well, I suppose I'm here because I have a hard time staying seated. 

Like during staff meetings at the school, or at dinner... everyone else will be sitting, and I just keep getting up. I'll suddenly go to refill my coffee, or check a handout, or just walk to the back of the room. Even when nothing is really urgent. I just... get up. That's pretty much it.
When you’re sitting and then get up, do you feel an inner sense of restlessness or pressure in your body that makes it hard to stay seated?
I'm not really sure what you mean by pressure. I haven't noticed anything like that. I just... stand up.
When you get up from your seat, is it because you feel compelled to check or fix something, even when you know it probably doesn’t need checking?
No, I don't think so. It's not like I'm looking for something to fix or check on. I just... find myself standing up. That's all.
When you stand up, is it usually because something in the room distracts you and pulls your attention away?
No, not really. I don't... I'm not getting distracted by things around me. I just stand up.
When this happens, do you also feel unusually energetic?
No... I wouldn't say energetic. I'm just... standing.
When you suddenly stand up, is it ever because you hear a voice telling you to get up?
No... definitely not. I don't hear anything like that. I just get up.
When you suddenly stand up, is it because you feel worried or on edge?
No. I'm not... worried. Just... restless, I suppose.
Is the restlessness strongest when you’re trying to sit still?

Yes... I suppose so. Like when I'm sitting at my desk grading essays, or... in church. I just catch myself tapping my foot. Or clicking my pen. Just shifting around a lot, until I have to... remind myself to settle down.
Did this restlessness start after you began taking a new medication or changed the dose of one?
No. I haven't... started any new medications. Or changed anything like that.
Did you have this same kind of trouble sitting still when you were a child?

Yes... I suppose it's always been that way. Um... my old report cards usually said I was bright, but... that I couldn't stay in my seat, or wait my turn. My mother used to joke about it. She'd say I wore a path between my desk and the pencil sharpener... before I was even ten years old.
